resources.string: Audio-first client foundation ready. Base engines, Room persistence, Media3 lifecycle guard, and D-pad rail are initialized.
Guest search integration via ArchiveTune Core is wired in :core:music. Interactive TV search UI arrives in Milestone M2.
Room database schema v1 is initialized with strict Guest vs Account scope isolation and 128 MB max dynamic cache policy.

Alunara is an independent YouTube Music client developed for Android TV. Its music integration is built on ArchiveTune Core (github.com/rukamori/core) and its lyrics integration is built on ArchiveTune Lyrics (github.com/rukamori/lyrics), open-source projects by rukamori. Alunara is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by ArchiveTune. Licensed under GNU GPL v3.0.
